d: Software designer Bruce Cleland marries a young, vivacious woman, then a carjacking leaves Cleland dead and prompts police to uncover a story of sex, money and hidden agendas.
A brutal slaying in Connecticut leaves police with no leads or suspects. A couple in California desperately searches for their missing son. In each case, police turn to psychics for guidance.
Sandy is shot two days before her wedding to Dave. The consequent investigation reveals an ex, and a mystery woman were involved, and not a botched robbery as first suspected.
